minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special Meeting of the City Council

  October 7, 2011

A Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to
order by Mayor Leckness at 4:40 p.m., on October 7, 2011, at 200 Civic Center, Mission
Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the special meeting containing all items as shown herein
was posted by 4:30 p.m. on October 6, 2011, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall.
Copies were also posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso
Drive, and the Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem Ury
  Mayor Leckness

Absent:  Council Member Reardon

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  W. Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Leckness

 PUBLIC COMMENTS

 Larry Gilbert, M.V.: asked why this issue could not have been addressed at the Council
 Meeting on October 3, 2011, and whether or not there would be a vote in open session this
 evening.

 CLOSED SESSION

  CS1. Conference with the City’s Real Property Negotiators Pursuant to
  Government Code Section 54956.8. Real property Denoted as Assessor’s
  Parcel No. 784-291-01 with a Common Street Address of 24701 San Doval,
  Mission Viejo, California, Commonly Known as O’Neill Elementary School
  Owned by Saddleback Valley Unified School District The Negotiating Parties
  are: City of Mission Viejo; Dennis Wilberg, City Manager, Keith Rattay,

City Council Minutes  1  October 7, 2011
   Assistant City Manager, Charles Wilson, Director of Community
  Development, and William Curley, III, City Attorney. Owner Negotiators are:
  Saddleback Valley Unified School District, Clint Harwick, Superintendent.
  Under Negotiation will be the Price and Terms of a Lease-Hold Interest in the
  Real Property.

 RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

 At the hour of 4:43 p.m., Mayor Leckness recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The
 City Council reconvened at 5:08 p.m. with four City Council Members present (Council
 Member Reardon was absent.)

 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

 City Attorney Bill Curley announced that the Council discussed further terms that have
 been exchanged between the City and Saddleback Valley Unified School District
 representatives. He noted that the City’s goal has always been focused on what is best for
 the community and how to accomplish a safe, positive, beneficial use of the O’Neill
 facility. The Council has come to determine that its greatest interest is less in the structure
 (building) on the property and more in the sports fields. Because the School District is
 facing timelines and protocols for putting the property out to bid to third parties, the
 Council addressed the matter again in this special session. The Council appears to have a
 consensus position and Mr. Curley recommended that they take formal action in open
 session. He further announced that staff will advance and continue negotiations for joint
 collegiate use of the fields for community sports activities and staff should be tasked with
 revisiting the city’s zoning structure as regards the school site property.

 CITY ATTORNEY’S REPORT

 1.  Request for Direction as Regards Zoning Moratoriums and the General Plan:
  Surplus School Site Property (oral report only)

  Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to (1)
  terminate the negotiations for lease-hold interest of the O’Neill Elementary School
  property; (2) pursue joint use of the sports field control; and (3) direct staff to come
  back with recommendations as to alternative zoning and general plan designations
  for future Council action.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Reardon

City Council Minutes  2  October 7, 2011
  City Attorney Curley indicated that he would relay information regarding the Council’s
 action to the School District’s legal counsel.

 ADJOURNMENT

 At the hour of 5:15 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this
 session, Mayor Leckness adjourned the meeting to Monday, October 17, 2011, at 5:00 p.m.

 ______________________________________________
 Karen Hamman, City Clerk

 Approved at the meeting of October 17, 2011

City Council Minutes  3  October 7, 2011
